messages:
IncidentBot: Pager triggered: gpu-pool-usw2 spot pool experiencing mass evictions. queue_depth=372, median_latency=6.1s, p95=18.6s, evictions_per_min=9.7. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Potential customer impact: increased latency and throttled requests. Paging oncall-sre.

maria.k: hitting this now, seeing 503s for a subset of requests. dashboard shows autoscaler stuck at 12/12 max for spot pool.

ajay: confirming — autoscaler error in logs: 
```
Error: scaleUpLimitReached: requested 8 nodes, limit 0 (quota/insufficient fallback capacity)
Stack: autoscaler/core.go:482
```

danielle: looks like fallback dedicated pool didn't accept traffic — routing policy returned 429s, reason: tag mismatch on instance groups.

infra-bot: autoscaler events (recent):
- 1742101080: scaleUpAttempt 8 -> failed (QuotaExceeded)
- 1742101102: spot eviction spike -> drain 21 pods
- 1742101120: routing policy fallback tried -> denied (group-tag check)

oncall-sre: I'm on the bridge. quick triage: are critical customers being rate-limited or seeing errors? need negative customer impact assessment.

maria.k: CS reports 3 paying customers reporting degraded experience (chat timeouts). internal metrics: error_budget burn 2.6% in last 15m.

ajay: mitigation plan proposal:
1) Force-route high-priority customer traffic to dedicated pool (if any free capacity)
2) Temporarily pause spot autoscaler scale-down and increase drain tolerance to reduce churn
3) Open emergency capacity request with cloud provider for +4 GPUs in us-west2 dedicated pool
4) Fix routing policy tag mismatch (quick patch)

ops_lead: prioritize 1 and 2 immediately. danielle, can you validate tag mismatch and flip allowlist?

danielle: on it — investigating IAM/instance-group tags now. will revert once validated.

ajay: command to check pods backlog:
```bash
kubectl get deploy -n inference -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
kubectl get hpa -n inference --watch
kubectl get pods -n inference -l route=gpu-spot -o wide | wc -l
```

maria.k: ran pod count — 380 pending/queued tasks, 58 running on spot nodes. CPU fine, GPU memory pressure high.

oncall-sre: danielle, any ETA on the tag flip? if >10m we should start forced routing.

danielle: tag mismatch is due to config-change from yesterday rollout. patch ready, will apply in 3 minutes.

infra-bot: applied patch: routing-allowlist updated for dedicated-pool-usw2 at 1742101160.

ajay: verifying routing now...
maria.k: I can see a small drop in queued jobs, some immediate retries succeeding. error rate down from 6% -> 2.1%.

oncall-sre: still seeing scaleUpLimitReached in autoscaler logs — fallback capacity not sufficient to absorb full spike. we should enable rate-limiting for non-critical routes to prevent queue blowout.

ops_lead: action: enable per-route soft-throttles for /v1/embeddings and low-priority batch routes. danielle please coordinate with gateway to set throttle=30rps for those routes.

danielle: throttle applied via envoy rate-limit config at 1742101184.

maria.k: new metrics — queue depth down to 220, p95 latency back to 9.2s, errors slowly decreasing. still some customers in retries.

oncall-sre: opening incident ticket (INC-2026-214) for follow-up: capacity planning, autoscaler tuning, on-call blameless postmortem. assign to infra and runtime.

ajay: longer-term notes captured in ticket: consider making dedicated-burst auto-unlock policy for emergencies, and better pre-authorized cloud requests to avoid quota errors. also add test that simulates mass spot evictions.

ops_lead: good work team. immediate mitigations held things. next steps: postmortem, customer comms for affected accounts, and schedule capacity increase. handoff to morning oncall at 1742101198 — I'll summarize final state.

oncall-sre: handoff: queue stable at 210, autoscaler at 12/16 (partial scale), no new evictions, dedicated routing fixed. monitoring for 60m.

maria.k: note for morning: retain logs from 1742101000-1742101300 and attach HPA, autoscaler, and routing-policy diffs.

ops_lead: closing active paging. reopen if regressions occur. :white_check_mark:
